title: Fitts tells Tucker Carlson the money goes to space
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Fitts tells Tucker Carlson the money goes to space, about an unknown time at Tucker Carlson interview, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And I I believe in her Tucker Carlson interview she mentions your work and he's like, "Where is all this money going?" And she goes, "Well, talk to Richard Dolan." And she goes, "Space."

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, recalls an interview that a woman named Katherine Austin Fitts gave to Tucker Carlson, a well-known television and podcast interviewer. According to Michels, Carlson asked her where all the missing money was going, and she told him to talk to Richard Dolan, the writer who was Michels' guest that day, and then answered with one word: "Space." It gets told because, if true, it would mean large sums of hidden government money are being spent on a secret space effort.
